review: Liu Assoc. South Section 4 Ryoshu Liu Ryoshu is a decent burn ID, focused on dealing damage first and applying burn potency at the same time. While at the base, her rolls might not be impressive at all, taking into consideration the fact that burn is the easiest status to maintain on the enemies, her conditional coin power-ups and clash power-ups won’t be hard to activate. While her Skill 1 being of gluttony sin seems awkward at first, is good to have to fuel any other additional E.G.O. you may have equipped at the time. Worth noting, unlike previous Liu IDs, Ryoshu has no blunt damage-dealing skills, instead has two slash and one pierce damage-dealing skills, covering Liu's weakness of facing enemies who are blunt resistant.
